articles.title: Rocks From the Moon's Far Side Help Solve a Mystery
articles.summary: Rocks from the Moon's far side suggest Earth's gravity heated one side more, giving the Moon two different faces.

articles.title: A Forgotten Fossil Turns Out to Be a New Dinosaur
articles.summary: A skull fossil forgotten for nearly 100 years is a new clawed dinosaur, the first of its kind found in Europe.

articles.title: AI Finds Thousands of Hidden Steps for Turning CO2 Into Fuel
articles.summary: Scientists used AI to find 9,389 reactions that help turn carbon dioxide into the fuel methanol.
